inner(gradient F_e(r*zeta),zeta)=c_n*(r-zeta0)/D^(n/2). Actual normalized zero flux, both internal L1 facts and c_n!=0 imply r*I0-I1=0. L1 justifies factoring/linearity and rules out relying on a totalized nonintegrable zero integral. Therefore I1=r/(1-r^2).
